description: This file defines the class RowIterator, which implements iteration functionality over the rows of a worksheet in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to navigate through worksheet rows, such as resetStart, resetEnd, seek, rewind, and check validity, encapsulating logical iteration over worksheet data.

classes.name: RowIterator
classes.description: Iterator implementation for traversing rows within a worksheet, maintaining current position and range, and providing navigation methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new RowIterator object for a given worksheet, with optional start and end row positions.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that nullifies the worksheet reference.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Sets the start row for iteration and seeks to that position, with validation against the worksheet's highest row.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Sets the end row for iteration, defaulting to the highest row of the worksheet.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the current position to a specified row, validating range constraints.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the current position to the start row.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current row object at the iterator's position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous row.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the defined range of rows.
